recent_events: Residents are protesting in the barangay over worsening public services and corruption. Anger at the current officials is rising and many are calling for change in the next election. Residents named Isidro Cruz-Soriano, Victor David, Xavier Cruz among those they hold responsible.

Election survey by Ulysses Cruz-Tan: based on interviews with 30 residents, Barangay Captain — Noel Cruz-Canete 27%, Theresa Salazar-Bernal 27%, Ligaya David 10%; Mayor — Nina Salazar-Cojuangco 47%, Teresita Cruz-Quinto 20%, Miguel Salazar-Pascual 13%.

Residents are protesting in the barangay over worsening public services and corruption. Anger at the current officials is rising and many are calling for change in the next election. Residents named Bernardo Cruz-Macapagal, Vanessa Cruz-Bonifacio, Hernando Cruz-Valdez among those they hold responsible.
